2.293.6
Style.Border
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Style.Border element specifies the default border properties for a report item. This element is
optional and is of type Border.
Following is the parent element of the Style.Border element.
Parent elements
Style
 The following is the XML Schema definition of the Style.Border element.
 <xsd:element name="Border" type="BorderType" minOccurs="0" />
